title: Prove the common-span four-term triple-reader floor
body:
## Summary

```text
three target groups: d,d,e with e<=d
  two largest groups share one binary span V
    distinct joint reader-annihilator atoms
      residual VVV/MMM bill >=3d
        sharp arbitrary-four-term triple floor 2d+e
```

Prove this common-span floor over every coefficient field, with arbitrary ambient factors. The third group may have external directions. This is a scoped obstruction; differing group spans remain open. No supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The new joint-atom lemma replaces a literal geometric census under this hypothesis. The full corollary retains PR3538's exact reduction proof and canonical PR3513/PR3505 premises. All runtime and proof sources are local and pinned. Credit retains Nick Petalas's predecessors, Philippe Van Velzen and Arham Tahir/PR3345, Tekalign/PR3370 and their retained lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3538 proved the four-term triple floor on the literal 4,960-triple partition; its different-partition question remained open.
  **After:** The common-span theorem covers arbitrary finite dimensions under the stated hypothesis. Two implementations agree on 36,000 fixture bills and 2,780 joint-atom assignments, with 9,120 integer and 6,840 gauged finite-field operator entries.
- Seven optimized CLI faults reject with restored positives. Both complete inherited classification implementations pass. Focused Ruff checks and formatting pass.
- At `a419035441dc386a6c57ec2e2505d882117daf97`, the registered CPython3.12 suite, metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history gates pass. All five scientific/control commands pass in a Git-free committed-byte export; all21 source/export files stay unchanged. Exact results, commands, sources and limits are in the package.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-common-span-triple-floor
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-common-span-triple-floor --check-source-history
```

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The full selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, physical supplier and multiplication-theorem obligations are not run or discharged here.

An isolated research package; no shared verifier or selected-frontier file changes.
